text:
Unfortunately, live plants can't be returned for change of mind, so a pothos you simply don't like the look of isn't eligible for a return, even though you're only 10 days in. The only routes for live plants are the Plant Care Guarantee or Damaged on Arrival. The latter needed a report within 48 hours of delivery and only covers damage like snapped stems or a dead plant. I don't have the Plant Care Guarantee details here, so I can't say whether it applies, but I can escalate to a Support Lead if the plant has an actual problem.

On shipping: original shipping is only refunded when the whole order is returned because of our error, so it wouldn't apply here. If your order included non-living items (like a pot), those can be returned within 30 days of delivery if unused and in original packaging, but the shipping still wouldn't be refunded.
